title: Fairness-Optimized Synthetic EHR Generation for Arbitrary Downstream Predictive Tasks

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating downstream mortality prediction models by calculating Disparate Impact (DI) and the Worst-performing True Positive Rate (WTPR) across different ethnic subgroups (e.g., White, Black, Hispanic, Asian, Han, Miao) using both real and synthetic electronic health records (EHR).
